subject: carpetforce & time to deployment | Boston Dynamics
text:
Hi [NAME],  

 i've been following Shark for a while and saw the CarpetForce launch. A new sensor modality means a new label set, which takes up a lot of engineering time during the curation and annotation process. 

 We work with Boston Dynamics and Thoro, an indoor robotics company, on exactly this. Thoro cut labelling and QA time by 50%, with each reviewer covering twice as many images as before. BD did even better.  

 If you're interested, would be great to chat further this week.  

 Please let me know.

subject: Encord re-connect
text:
Hi [NAME] - hope you're doing well,

Congratulations on the new role at Hive, and on yesterday's funding announcement - exciting times ahead! 

I know you spoke with my colleagues [SENDER] and [SENDER] last year while you were at Humanoid. I've been following Hive's growth, and it looks like you're entering a new phase of scale with global deployments and US expansion. I imagine adapting quickly to new environments - whether tunnels, quarries, or logistics sites - is a key focus. 

It would be great to catch up and hear more about your priorities. Since those conversations last year, we've launched several new platform capabilities, as well as a data collection warehouse providing high-quality teleoperated and egocentric data for robotics teams. 

Do you have 30 minutes to connect next week?

subject: Surgical AI Dinner SRS - 23 July
text:
Hi [NAME], pleasure to meet you. 

 My CEO [SENDER] wanted me to let you know he will be hosting an exclusive networking dinner during SRS for surgical AI leaders to share their experience and challenges building AI in surgery and medtech. 

 The evening will take place at The Salon at the Premier Steakhouse, Diplomat Prime on Thursday 23rd July. Encord's founder and senior medtech team will be there, and we expect great conversation with attendees ranging from surgical robotics startups to established medtech leaders. 

 Encord runs this type of event across major conferences and tech hubs. The agenda stays entirely attendee-led, with no slides or presentations, to keep us up to speed on what is state-of-the-art in surgical AI. 

 We'd love to have you join if you're interested. Happy to send a formal invite if you are.

subject: [NAME] <> [SENDER] (Encord) Reconnect
text:
Hi [NAME],

I recently joined Encord (we're in the process of building a new office on
the East Coast & just joined as first boots on the ground in NYC).

Heard great things about your work from [SENDER] and the team from your
evaluation of Encord in [YEAR]/5.

He mentioned at the time you were deciding between a few options for
annotation tooling (V7, Labelbox) & the decision was to go with lower
cost/shorter engagement for [YEAR] and then decide for longer term. Would it
be worth reconnecting the three of us to catch up on updates since you guys
last spoke?

We've since started working w/ handful of teams working on
aerial/geospatial annotation (Zesty, Tractable, Maxar) and also separate
regulated/legal tech OCR-based use cases (TR Group and also some of the
hyper-growth legal tech AI startups) so could be worth catching up on all.

[SENDER] is in London next week but mornings your time are fairly open - if you
let me know when's best I can circulate an invite.
